narrative.gap_prioritization_md: Gaps were prioritized using the 6-factor priority framework: Business Impact (25%), Risk Severity (20%), Competitive Gap (20%), Effort Inverse (15%), Quick Win Potential (10%), Trend Alignment (10%). Each factor scored 1-5, weighted, and summed to produce a Priority Score (max 5.0).
